The other two doors (entrance 1.00 m, bathroom 0.90 m) are drawn correctly with the closed leaf coinciding with the gap, which confirms this one is a drafting error rather than a convention.

structured_output.summary: The drawn geometry is internally consistent and exactly 1:100 (shell measures 10.000 x 7.000 m, matching the overall dimensions), but the annotation on top of it is not: two chain dimensions are wrong (5.86 should be 5.80; 4.00 should be 3.485), so the chain sums to 10.575 m instead of 10.00 m, and all three room areas are understated (WOHNEN 31.2 vs 37.12, SCHLAFEN 13.4 vs 14.24, BAD 6.9 vs 7.67 m2 — 51.5 vs 59.0 m2 in total). Separately, the WOHNEN/SCHLAFEN door leaf and swing are drawn one door-width above the actual opening in the partition, so the opening has no door and the leaf sits on solid wall. Please correct the labels to match the geometry (or the geometry, if 4.00 m was the design intent — that choice changes the overall width) and re-place the bedroom door symbol before issuing; also note that BAD is only reachable through SCHLAFEN, which you may want to revisit.
